subject: organic
question:
有机化学·保护基化学：下列哪组反应条件能够脱除所示保护基：tert-Butyl ester（tert-butyl ester）？
A. TFA, CH₂Cl₂
B. PhSH, K₂CO₃, DMF
C. HgCl₂, CaCO₃, MeCN/H₂O
D. AcOH, THF/H₂O
explanation: A bulky ester that resists saponification and nucleophiles; acid (TFA) removes it. Leaves as the tert-butyl cation (then isobutylene), like Boc.
